name: Annex I, after subheading 1 – 130
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: Sections I, II, and III shall also apply, subject to their respective conditions, to projects that a Member State has classified as strategic pursuant to Article 14(2a) or (2b). For the purposes of this Annex, such projects shall be considered projects in strategic sectors or categories.
